knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(openxlsx)
```


## Set paths
```{r}
list.files("../../../2019_HTS_course/wetlab/protocols/")

sample_layout.file = "../../../2019_HTS_course/wetlab/protocols/sample_and_library_info.xlsx"
excel_sheets(sample_layout.file)
```

## Get Wells from Plate Layout
```{r}
read_excel(sample_layout.file, sheet="2019_lab_plate", skip=5) %>%
  select(-X__2) %>%
  rename(row = X__1) %>%
  filter(!is.na(row)) %>%
  select(1:7)  ->
  well_layout.df
well_layout.df
```
```{r}
well_layout.df %>%
  gather(key="col", "Label", -row) %>%
  mutate(Well=paste0(row,col)) %>%
  select(Label, Well) ->
  samples_with_wells.df
```

## Get Barcodes from Plate Layout
```{r}
read_excel(sample_layout.file, sheet="2019_lab_plate", skip=6) %>%
  select(-X__1) %>%
  rename(I5_Index_ID = X__2) ->
  plate_layout.df

plate_layout.df
```

```{r}
gather(plate_layout.df, key="I7_Index_ID", "Label", -I5_Index_ID) %>%
  arrange(I5_Index_ID, I7_Index_ID) ->
  sample_indices.df
sample_indices.df
```

## Get Barcode sequences
```{r}
nextseq_barcode_url="https://www.neb.com/-/media/nebus/files/excel/e7600_nextseq_v4.csv?la=en&rev=d332d2b116c24d9295e5967f940218df&hash=2AF55A100FDFD07F4E4504504FB01DA6D825D8CC"
read_csv(nextseq_barcode_url, skip=18) %>%
  select(I7_Index_ID, 
         I7_Index_Seq=index,
         I5_Index_ID, 
         I5_Index_Seq=index2) %>%
  mutate(I7_Index_ID=str_replace(I7_Index_ID, "D", "i"),
         I5_Index_ID=str_replace(I5_Index_ID, "D", "i")) ->
  index_seqs.df

index_seqs.df %>%
  select(starts_with("I7")) ->
  i7_sequences

index_seqs.df %>%
  select(starts_with("I5")) %>%
  distinct ->
  i5_sequences
```

## Merge Sequences with Samples
```{r}
sample_indices.df %>%
  left_join(i7_sequences) %>%
  left_join(i5_sequences) %>%
  left_join(samples_with_wells.df) ->
  samples_with_index_seqs
samples_with_index_seqs
```

Code	Version	Type	Label	Plate	Well	Organism	Conc.	Volume	Size	i7 index	i5 index	Pool
L-1	1	RNA-Seq	1_A	1	A1	Cryptococcus neoformans		20	200	ATTACTCG	AGGCTATA	A



```{r}
samples_with_index_seqs %>%
  transmute(
    Code=paste("L", 1:n(),sep="-"),
    Version=1, 
    Type="RNA-Seq",
    Label,
    Plate=1,
    Well,
    Organism="Cryptococcus neoformans",
    Conc="",
    Volume=20,
    Size=200,
    "i7 index"=I7_Index_Seq,
    "i5 index"=I5_Index_Seq,
    Pool="A") ->
  sample_submission.df
```
```{r}
write.xlsx(sample_submission.df, "order_5728_corrected.xlsx")
```
